name: citations
description: Two offline modes for checking that a document's claims trace to real sources, without ever fetching a URL itself. Mode 'extract': given markdown text, finds every link and every quoted claim (>= 8 words) near a link, so you know what needs verifying. Mode 'match': given claimed quotes and page text YOU supply for each source URL, checks whether each quote actually appears on that page (normalized substring match). This tool does no network access — you must obtain page text yourself (e.g. with a fetch tool) and pass it in for mode 'match'.

markdown.description: Required for mode 'extract': the markdown document text.

claims.description: Required for mode 'match': claims to verify.

sources.description: Required for mode 'match': map of url -> page text you already fetched. May be raw HTML; tags are stripped before comparison.
